summary: Controls how closely a Stability style-control request follows the supplied reference. Higher fidelity preserves more reference appearance; lower fidelity gives the prompt and generated composition more freedom.
combines: Applies only to the Stability control or style route that accepts fidelity and a compatible reference image.
It combines with control strength, style strength, change strength, and the text prompt; pushing several strengths high can overconstrain the result.
Lixpi fixes it inside provider-neutral reference adaptation, so it is not exposed independently from the selected conditioning mode.

usage.from: the pipeline-owned STYLE_CONTROL_FIDELITY constant, fixed at 0.7
usage.what: Controls how closely a direct Stability style-control result follows the reference style. Bedrock does not receive this field and instead uses image-to-image strength.

note: Fixed internally for style-control routing; not user-configurable.
